# Code review only

When performing a pull request review, use the
[game-quality-code-review skill](skills/game-quality-code-review/SKILL.md)
for changes that affect the player experience, including scenes, shared UI,
gameplay systems, models, persistence, balancing/content Resources, and mobile
configuration. Review indirect cross-screen effects, not just UI diffs.

Prioritize evidence-backed regressions; keep optional design improvements
separate and non-blocking. These instructions apply only to reviews, do not
authorize edits, and do not replace the repository's [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
